list_blog_categories.code:
response = client.blog_categories.list_blog_categories({"limit": 20, "offset": 0})
for category in response.map["blog_categories"]:
    print(category["id"], category["name"], category["url"])
pagination = response.map["pagination"]
print(pagination["total"], pagination["has_next"])

get_blog_category.code:
response = client.blog_categories.get_blog_category(15)
category = response.map["blog_category"]
print(category["name"], category["url"], category["description"])
print(category["created_on"], category["last_updated_on"])
